[[Brohn's Holy Rod]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Brohn Stoneheart]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Healing Prayers]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:Halves casting time of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the modifications that are required ("Wand Wrapping of Memory") would instead halve the skill recharge of Divine Favor spells.
